helix-jump.title: Helix Jump - Free Online Ball Bouncing Game
helix-jump.description: Helix Jump is a casual game with simple and addictively fun mechanics. In the game, you guide a bouncing ball continuously down a series of circular platforms until you crash. Fall through the cracks and avoid landing in the forbidden zones! Play Helix Jump now and experience the thrill of this engaging ball-bouncing challenge.
